mechanism: Both agents are CNS depressants that can cause additive sedation, dizziness, and impaired coordination; cenobamate may inhibit CYP2C19 which can affect baclofen metabolism to a minor degree.
action: Monitor patients for increased CNS depression including sedation, ataxia, and cognitive impairment; counsel on avoiding alcohol and other CNS depressants; consider dose adjustment if excessive CNS effects occur.
